cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay while we test Gran's prophecy. This stone should hatch at sunset; I need a second witness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's gone. I'll write 'Gran was wrong' and go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Record an observation, not a verdict. 'No hatch at sunset.' Then sign it, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep the pen. We need Gran on the phone before you leave. Put her on speaker; I'll ask for a date.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects verdict into observation and A5 takes charge of revising the missing date, keeping B present through expert reporting rather than arbitrary delay.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to leave after a result, while B4 cooperates and improves the test's validity.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 missing day to require B's continued presence for responsible revision with Gran.
